backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing blob storage, trending media, user profiles, tracked shows, and role‑based access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to frontend files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and UI behavior of major frontend components and hooks.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file showing how to provide an optional TMDB API key.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for build artifacts, logs, editor files, node_modules, and environment files.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document containing the root div and script entrypoint for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component managing media selection, modal state, profile setup logic, and rendering FeaturedRow, NetflixTop10, and ContentGrid.
frontend/src/components/AddShowDialog.ts: Dialog for searching and adding TV shows to a user's tracked list with API calls and error handling.
Banner that warns the user when the TMDB API is unhealthy or using a fallback API key.
frontend/src/components/ContentGrid.tsx: Component fetching and displaying trending content with loading, error, and empty states using MediaCard items.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx: Fetches and displays featured content as a horizontally scrollable row with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/FilterBar.tsx: Provides dropdown controls for filtering media by type and sorting options with optional badges.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with credits and TMDB attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the site header with branding and login/logout handling via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Shows a hero banner with a background image, title, and subtitle.
frontend/src/components/MediaCard.tsx: Displays media item details with poster, rating, trailer button, and tracked TV show interactions.
frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx: Loads and displays the top 10 trending items in a grid with ranking indicators.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for entering and saving a user profile name on first setup.
frontend/src/components/TrackedShows.tsx: Shows the user's tracked TV shows with loading/error states, removal actions, and new episode indicators.
frontend/src/components/TrailerModal.tsx: Modal component that fetches and displays a media trailer, handling loading, errors, iframe resets, and dev diagnostics.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, providing login, logout, and identity state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for TMDB data fetching, trailer retrieval, API health checks, and backend interactions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes, gradients, animations, and custom scrollbars.
frontend/src/lib/devDiagnostics.ts: Development-only logging utilities for tracking trailer, media, and iframe events without exposing sensitive data.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Type definitions for Vite environment variables, including the TMDB API key.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with dark mode, custom OKLCH color variables, extended animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Captures the project's current architecture, features, known issues, and versioning for a React/Vite + Motoko app integrating TMDB and Internet Identity.
